comments.value: Hello!  Thanks for reporting this.  Is this issue still occurring?

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name} Had tried around a week ago and got the same old die immediately after EAC launcher window, but I just now tried it again and the current beta actually launched. So... Maybe all good? Will know for sure once this one goes live. Thanks!
Thank you for reporting this issue. However, since the post is quite old and hasn't been updated recently, we encourage you to create a new ticket if the problem still persists.

details:
Using Debian 10, ge-proton 7-10, both Steam stable and beta clients, as soon as VRChat gets past the EAC loading screen it dies with the stop button in Steam going back to play. Does not appear to even attempt to launch VRChat itself as there isn't an output_log created. 

Running the VRChat.exe through ge-proton 7-10 directly via the console did successfully load the game into the error world as it should, with both launch.exe and start_protected_game.exe dieing just after the initial EAC loading screen.. 

Tried using the exact same Steam library folder/vrchat install in Debian 12 on the same computer with ge-proton 7-10, and there it all worked fine.

edit: 

same issue with 1433. EAC launcher goes through it's loading screen then fails to start the game. It does appear to see the VRChat.exe, because if I change the filename in EAC's Settings.json, it throws up an error that it couldn't find the file... But for some reason it just won't run it.

Finally found the EAC logfile location... Only thing I'm seeing is that something's being called with invalid parameters near the end, not sure if that's the issue or not...
